correctness.rationale: Graph modeled by an explicit 12-vertex 30-edge, five-regular, girth-three, diameter-three adjacency list; graph Čech parity formula checked against Adams–Shukla–Singh Lemma 2.2. The stored certificates cover all 446 and 2037 nonempty simplices at scales 2 and 3 with respectively 222 and 1013 codimension-one matches, and a full topological sort of 1572 and 9924 oriented Hasse incidences proves both gradients acyclic. Critical cells (one vertex plus one 2-cell; one vertex plus ten 4-cells) give the integral wedges through Forman’s theorem. Complete distance enumeration proves all twelve antipodal complements at scale 4 and a full simplex at scale 5. The exact integral barcodes follow because nonzero homology degrees are disjoint at consecutive integer scales; scale constancy for all real r is supplied by the owning Čech source. Separate mod-two boundary rank computations corroborate but are not misused as integral proofs.

evidence: The hypercube homotopy computations assume the graph is a binary Hamming cube; the icosahedron is 5-regular and contains triangles.

Matsushita Theorem 1.2 relates suspensions to independence complexes of double covers and Example 3.5 concerns Cartesian products of complete graphs. No cited exact homotopy type of the present closed-neighborhood icosahedron follows without an additional computation.
Previte treats paths, unicyclic graphs and cycles among her principal explicit graph families; the icosahedron is neither of those.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Relevant general functorial equivalences and small-scale recovery results do not determine the exact integral ranks or four distinct positive-dimensional stages. The source recovery range r<girth/2 ends at r<1.5 for the triangular icosahedral graph and does not cover scales 2–4.

originality.rationale: Targeted checks of equivalent closed-neighborhood, distance-neighborhood, Čech nerve and real-scale persistence terminology found no exact icosahedral intrinsic Čech classification or stronger theorem whose conclusion implies it. The icosahedral open-neighborhood calculation has distinct face sets and rank 23 rather than rank 1 in degree two, so it does not cover the closed-neighborhood calculation. Full relevant portions of the Adams–Shukla–Singh, Previte and Matsushita primary texts and the published same-graph open-neighborhood RESULT were materially read. The index and accessible primary literature cannot exclude unindexed work.
residual_risks: An unindexed or obscure exact computation might exist under reflexive graph, radius-one neighborhood nerve or Platonic-solid terminology.

value.rationale: A full integral homotopy and persistence classification of the canonical icosahedral graph at every scale is a natural structurally motivated invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice. It records successive concentration in homology dimensions 1, 2, 4 and 10, establishes exact zero-length-one differential barcode intervals, integral torsion-freeness, and intermediate pure-complex non-shellability. Results on hypercubes and open neighborhoods do not imply it. The result remains a finite-graph benchmark rather than a claimed general theorem.
